title: Changes to group assignment are not saved and revert to the previous group
description: When attempting to change the group assigned to a light fixture and then saving the changes, the application does not retain the new selection and reverts to the previously assigned group. A 'Changes saved successfully' message is displayed, but the assignment remains unchanged.
steps: Navigate to System Setup > Assign Lights.
Tap on the existing group listed under 'New group' (e.g., '7: Almendro').
From the list of groups, select a new group (e.g., '10: Higuera').
Tap 'OK' on the 'Assign Lights' dialog box which states 'Changes saved successfully'.
Observe that the 'New group' field still displays the original group ('7: Almendro') instead of the newly selected group ('10: Higuera').
actual: After selecting a new group and confirming the save, the 'New group' field reverts to the original group assignment. The 'Changes saved successfully' dialog appears, but the UI does not reflect the intended change.
expected: After selecting a new group and confirming the save, the 'New group' field should display the newly selected group. The changes should be persistent.
